note: The OmniPro 220 uses a synergic auto-set LCD control system, not a printed numeric settings table. You select process, then turn the Left/Right knobs to set wire/rod/electrode diameter and material thickness; the machine auto-calculates recommended wire feed speed (or amperage) and voltage, shown live on the LCD (a white mark on the amperage/voltage bars also indicates the recommended setting if adjusted manually). There is no static 'material X + thickness Y -> voltage Z, wire speed W' table printed in the manual to look up instead. Do not report specific numeric WFS/voltage values as manual-backed facts for a given material/thickness -- the manual does not print them; the machine computes them live.
